actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Google Drive action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Google Drive connection OAuth scopes.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: add_permission
actions.title: Add permission to a file
actions.description: Add permission to a particular file in Google Drive
actions.help: This action adds permission to a particular file in Google Drive. Permissions are useful to transfer file ownership or to share a file to additional users, groups, domain or to anyone.

input.name: fileId
input.label: File
input.hint: File ID can be found in the output of other triggers/actions of Google Drive connector, or at the end of a file's shareable link provided by Drive.

input.name: role
input.label: Role
input.hint: The role granted by this permission.

input.name: type
input.label: Share with
input.hint: When creating a permission, if this is set to a user or group, you must provide the email address for the user or group. When it is set to domain, you must provide a domain

input.name: emailAddress
input.label: Email address
input.hint: Email address of the specific user or group to which the permission refers to. Required if Share with is selected as a user or group.

input.name: domain
input.label: Domain
input.hint: Domain to which the permission refers to. Required if Share with is selected as domain.

input.name: allowFileDiscovery
input.label: Allow file discovery?
input.hint: Whether the permission allows the file to be discovered through search. This is only applicable for permissions of type domain or anyone . Defaults to true .

input.name: sendNotificationEmail
input.label: Send notifications
input.hint: Whether to send notification to the user or the group about the permission. Not applicable if the file is shared to domain or anyone. Defaults to true for users and groups.

input.name: emailMessage
input.label: Notification message
input.hint: A plain text custom message to include in the notification email.

input.name: transferOwnership
input.label: Transfer ownership
input.hint: Transfer ownership of the file to the user provided. Requires Share with to be set to user and Role to be set as owner . Defaults to false .

input.name: moveToNewOwnersRoot
input.label: Move file to root of the user
input.hint: Moves the file to the new owner’s root folder. Requires “Transfer ownership” to be set to true. Default is set to false.

input.name: useDomainAdminAccess
input.label: Use domain admin access?
input.hint: Issues the request with Domain Admin Access if the user who is connected is the Domain Admin. Useful in setting permissions for Shared Drive files, wherein the user is the admin of the domain owning t…

input.label: File contents
input.hint: Contents of the file to upload.

input.label: File name
input.hint: Name of the uploaded file. If not specified, the uploaded file will be named as Untitled .

input.name: parents
input.label: Parent folder
input.hint: Select the parent folder. The uploaded file will be saved under My Drive if not specified. Either the drive or drive.readonly scope is necessary to populate the picklist. If neither is selected on the…

input.name: mimeType
input.label: Upload file MIME type
input.hint: This is the actual MIME type of the file which is being uploaded. Eg: image/jpeg . Google Drive will automatically detect an appropriate value from uploaded content if no value is provided.

input.name: targetMimeType
input.label: Target MIME type
input.hint: Learn more about specific limitations due to the API limitations when using this MIME type feature.

input.name: description
